title: Levni Folio prop
description: One drawing in library/props/<name>.json: SVG paths in a 0-100 box with colour names. `npm test` and `levni add` run the full check (src/validate.mjs); this schema is for editors and agents. Guide: CONTRIBUTING.md

name.description: Lowercase English, a-z0-9 and hyphens; equals the file name. No brand names (library/brand-words.json).

aliases.description: Old names of a renamed prop. Scenes that use an old name keep working.

tags.description: Search words in any language (English and Turkish welcome).

variants.description: A second angle or state of the same object is another variant, not another prop.

anyOf.description: Hex works but cannot be recoloured by style packs; prefer a name.

note.description: What this variant shows, e.g. "side view, spout to the right".

slots.description: Named places other elements can sit in: [x, y], [x, y, w, h] or [x, y, w, h, rotDegrees], all inside 0..100.

weight.description: Line width in output pixels: 8-10 outlines, 4-6 details.
